stories.title: Adolescente de 16 anos é morto a tiros em Fortaleza

en.title: 16-year-old teenager is shot dead in Fortaleza
en.summary: A 16-year-old was fatally shot in the José de Alencar neighborhood of Fortaleza on Saturday. Police believe the killing resulted from a dispute between criminal factions operating in the area.

stories.title: Operação da PF apura negociação de apoio eleitoral com facção na PB e apreende R$ 220 mil

en.title: Federal Police operation investigates negotiation of electoral support with faction in Paraíba and seizes R$ 220 thousand
en.summary: Federal Police launched an operation to investigate alleged negotiations between political agents and criminal faction members in Paraíba regarding electoral support. Authorities seized R$ 220 thousand during the action and executed seven search warrants.

stories.title: Acompanhe em tempo real os lances de Austrália x Brasil em jogo amistoso

en.title: Follow in real time the plays of Australia vs Brazil in friendly match
en.summary: Coverage of a friendly football match between Australia and Brazil.

stories.title: Pesquisa Palver mostra Lula e Flávio empatados com 44% no primeiro turno

en.title: Palver survey shows Lula and Flávio tied at 44% in first round
en.summary: A Palver institute poll released on Tuesday shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro tied at 44% in first round voting intentions.

stories.title: Homem que estava há 40 anos no corredor da morte é libertado nos EUA após novo exame de DNA

en.title: Man freed from death row in USA after 40 years following new DNA test
en.summary: A 71-year-old man imprisoned since 1985 was released after DNA evidence showed his genetic material did not match evidence from the crime scene. He was freed with electronic monitoring while awaiting further legal proceedings.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja a agenda dos candidatos ao Governo do Maranhão nesta terça-feira (29)

en.title: 2026 Elections: see the agenda of candidates for Governor of Maranhão on Tuesday (29)
en.summary: Eight candidates registered to run for governor of Maranhão began their election campaign activities. News outlets are tracking daily schedules of candidates as provided by political parties.

stories.title: Atlas/Estadão: Tarcísio tem 53,3% contra 40,1% de Haddad no 1º turno para governador de São Paulo

en.title: Atlas/Estadão: Tarcísio has 53.3% against 40.1% of Haddad in first round for governor of São Paulo
en.summary: A poll shows Tarcísio leading with 53.3% support compared to Haddad's 40.1% in the first round for São Paulo governor.

stories.title: Após empate frustrante, Brasil reencontra Austrália em novo amistoso

en.title: After frustrating draw, Brazil faces Australia again in new friendly
en.summary: Brazil and Australia meet for a second friendly match four days after drawing 1-1, this time in Brisbane. Coach Carlo Ancelotti is expected to make at least seven lineup changes from the previous encounter.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual Paraná (PR) 2026: veja lista com nomes e números para votar

en.title: Candidates for state deputy in Paraná (PR) 2026: see list with names and numbers to vote
en.summary: Paraná voters will choose their representatives for the State Legislative Assembly in the 2026 elections. A list of state deputy candidates with their names and voting numbers is available.

stories.title: Palver: Lula e Flávio têm 44% cada no 1º turno e empate técnico no 2º

en.title: Palver: Lula and Flávio each have 44% in first round and statistical tie in second
en.summary: A Palver survey shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied at 44% each in the first round of the presidential election, with a statistical tie also in the second round.

stories.title: RealTime Big Data: Tarcísio tem 53% contra 39% de Haddad no 1º turno

en.title: RealTime Big Data: Tarcísio has 53% against 39% of Haddad in first round
en.summary: A RealTime Big Data survey shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 53% support in the first round, ahead of Fernando Haddad with 39%.

stories.title: Confiança econômica da zona do euro recua em setembro

en.title: Economic confidence in the eurozone declines in September
en.summary: The Economic Sentiment Indicator for the eurozone fell to 97.9 in September 2026 from 98.4 in August, below market expectations of 99.0. Consumer confidence and inflation expectations worsened as concerns grew about rising oil prices and stalled negotiations to end the US-Iran conflict.

stories.title: Em quem tem que votar primeiro? Saiba a ordem nas eleições 2026

en.title: Who should you vote for first? Know the voting order in the 2026 elections
en.summary: Brazilian voters will cast ballots for federal deputies first in the 2026 general elections on October 4th. The voting sequence includes federal and state deputies, two Senate seats, governor and vice-governor, and finally president and vice-president.

stories.title: Capacitismo atinge 76% das pessoas com deficiência no mercado de trabalho

en.title: Ableism affects 76% of people with disabilities in the job market
en.summary: A survey found that three out of four people with disabilities or neurodiversity have experienced ableism at work. The study indicates that cisgender women and LGBTQIAPN+ community members are particularly impacted by these experiences.

stories.title: Inflação da Espanha sobe para 5,0% ao ano em setembro, maior nível em três anos e meio

en.title: Spain's inflation rises to 5.0% annually in September, highest level in three and a half years
en.summary: Spanish inflation reached 5.0% in September, its highest level since February 2023, following eight consecutive months of increases. The rate now exceeds the eurozone average as Spain's economy continues to outperform.

stories.title: Bolsas asiáticas caem após perdas em Wall Street

en.title: Asian stock exchanges fall after Wall Street losses
en.summary: Most Asian stock exchanges declined following losses on Wall Street, while US Treasury yields paused their upward trend after reaching a two-decade high.
